windowTitle: Serial integration stage 7 - complete the portable Candidate installation configuration
scope: Complete the Cloud-owned portable Candidate installation contract for the supported tencent-tke provider and for the per-binding application origin. Two source-proven owner facts were absent from the portable assets that ship and run those owners. No provider, cluster, Instance or production action.

findings.fact: services/fabric/internal/fabric/tencent_provider.go callKubectl runs protectedresource.FromEnv().Check(target) for every mutating kubectl verb (apply/create/patch/delete/scale); Config.Validate requires OPL_SYSTEM_COMPUTE_NODE_POOL_ID, _MACHINE_ID, _NODE_NAME, _MACHINE_TYPE and OPL_FABRIC_TENCENT_TKE_PROVIDER_PROFILE_JSON, so Fabric refuses every provider/cluster mutation while they are unset. compose.fabric-tencent-tke.yaml and opl-cloud.env.example declared none of the five OPL_SYSTEM_COMPUTE_* facts, although services/control-plane/ops/production-manifest.ts already requires them for a tencent-tke install.
findings.consequence: The portable tencent-tke Candidate could start Fabric but not mutate anything; the assets now forward the exact facts the guard reads.

findings.fact: services/control-plane/internal/server/workspace_application_origin.go parseWorkspaceApplicationOriginHost returns not-a-binding-origin when OPL_WORKSPACE_APPLICATION_DOMAIN is empty, and services/serve/internal/delivery/routeorigin.go uses the same name for ApplicationEntryURL. compose.yaml did not forward it and opl-cloud.env.example did not declare it, so an install built from the published template could not dispatch or publish the per-binding application origin that the Instance Ingress wildcard routes.
findings.consequence: The base Compose now forwards the declared value and the template declares the installer input, keeping the setting optional but explicit rather than undiscoverable.

verification.detail: The overlay forwards every fact protectedresource.FromEnv reads (read from guard.go), the template declares them, and the base Compose forwards the application-origin domain both readers use.
13 contract tests pass, including the retained portable Local-Docker asset and product-distribution tests.

Rendered with a disposable env file: Fabric receives the five OPL_SYSTEM_COMPUTE_* facts and OPL_FABRIC_PROVIDER=tencent-tke; Control Plane receives OPL_WORKSPACE_APPLICATION_DOMAIN=application.example.com. No image pull, provider call or cluster access.

verification.command: npm run test:ownership && npm run validate:product-boundary && npm run verify:local
verification.detail: Test ownership, product boundary and the full local gate (source tests, contract tests, Console browser suite, database-free Go tests, whitespace) are green.

notRun: Candidate image build (owner-actor dispatch) and Instance deployment.
Any Tencent provider or cluster mutation; no real charge, purchase, renewal or deletion.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims the portable Candidate assets now declare the protected-resource and application-origin facts their Cloud owners require and that the assets render with a disposable env. It claims no Candidate image, no deployed installation, no provider action and no Instance receipt.
